name: Clinical Site Details
description: Study-site level clinical trial data including site details, operational status, IRB/EC information, approval dates, protocol revision status, and history summaries.

Study.label: Study
Study.description: The unique identifier for the parent clinical study as assigned by the source system.

Title.label: Title
Title.description: The descriptive title or name of the clinical study.

Site Code.label: Site Code
Site Code.description: The unique site identifier assigned by the source system for a participating or nominated clinical trial site.

Site Name.label: Site Name
Site Name.description: The official or source-system name of the clinical trial site or institution.

Site Address.label: Site Address
Site Address.description: The primary street address for the clinical trial site.

Site City.label: Site City
Site City.description: The city where the clinical trial site is located.

Site State.label: Site State
Site State.description: The state, province, region, or source-system geographic code for the clinical trial site.

Site Zip.label: Site Zip
Site Zip.description: The postal or ZIP code for the clinical trial site.

Site Country.label: Site Country
Site Country.description: The country where the clinical trial site is located.

Site Status.label: Site Status
Site Status.description: The current operational status of the clinical trial site in the study. Observed values: ACTIVATED, APPROACH, CLOSED, COMPLIANCE/REG HOLD, DECLINED, END ENROLL, ENROLLING, HOLD, INA WTHDRN, NOMINATED, NOT OFFERED, PENDING, PRE CLOSE, WAIT LIST, WITHDRAWN.

Site CRA Name.label: Site CRA Name

IRB Chairman Name.label: IRB Chairman Name

IRB Name.label: IRB Name
IRB Name.description: The name of the institutional review board or ethics committee responsible for oversight or approval.

IRB Address 1.label: IRB Address 1
IRB Address 1.description: The first address line for the IRB or ethics committee.

IRB Address 2.label: IRB Address 2
IRB Address 2.description: The second address line for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

IRB Address 3.label: IRB Address 3
IRB Address 3.description: The third address line for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

IRB City.label: IRB City
IRB City.description: The city where the IRB or ethics committee is located.

IRB State.label: IRB State
IRB State.description: The state, province, region, or source-system geographic code for the IRB or ethics committee.

IRB Zip.label: IRB Zip
IRB Zip.description: The postal or ZIP code for the IRB or ethics committee.

IRB Country.label: IRB Country
IRB Country.description: The country where the IRB or ethics committee is located.

IRB Phone.label: IRB Phone
IRB Phone.description: The phone number for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

IRB Fax.label: IRB Fax
IRB Fax.description: The fax number for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

IRB Email.label: IRB Email
IRB Email.description: The email address for the IRB or ethics committee, when available.

IRB Local/Central.label: IRB Local/Central
IRB Local/Central.description: Indicates whether the IRB or ethics committee is categorized as local or central. Observed values: CENTRAL, LOCAL.

Original IRB/EC Approval Date.label: Original IRB/EC Approval Date
Original IRB/EC Approval Date.description: The original IRB or ethics committee approval date for the site and study.

Orig. IRB/EC Appr. Exp. Date.label: Orig. IRB/EC Appr. Exp. Date

IRB/EC Approval Exp. Date.label: IRB/EC Approval Exp. Date
IRB/EC Approval Exp. Date.description: The current expiration date associated with IRB or ethics committee approval.

IRB History Summary.label: IRB History Summary
IRB History Summary.description: A summarized history of IRB or ethics committee approval events, often represented as pipe-separated status entries.

Protocol History Summary.label: Protocol History Summary

Amendment History Summary.label: Amendment History Summary

name: Clinical Patient Details
description: Patient-level clinical trial data including study and site identifiers, patient demographics, consent/enrollment/procedure dates, randomization and cohort assignments, device implant details, withdrawal/death status, and monitoring dates.

STUDY.label: STUDY
STUDY.description: Sponsor/source-system study code identifying the clinical trial or registry record belongs to, such as CRD_1032, CRD_1003, or CRD_971. Used with SITE and PT/PT_LAST to associate the patient with the correct parent study.

STUDY_TITLE.label: STUDY_TITLE
STUDY_TITLE.description: Full study or registry title associated with STUDY, such as VANTAGE, SH Device Registry, ARIES HM3, or other trial names. Provides human-readable context for the study code.

SITE.label: SITE
SITE.description: Sponsor/source-system site code identifying the clinical trial site where the patient was consented, enrolled, implanted, followed, or screened, such as EU1883 or EU1957.

SITE_NAME.label: SITE_NAME
SITE_NAME.description: Name of the participating site, hospital, institution, or internal-use site associated with SITE.

CITY.label: CITY
CITY.description: City recorded for the clinical trial site.

STATE.label: STATE
STATE.description: State, province, region, or source-system geographic abbreviation for the clinical trial site.

COUNTRY.label: COUNTRY
COUNTRY.description: Country recorded for the clinical trial site.

PT.label: PT
PT.description: Patient/subject number within the study or site context. This is a source-system patient identifier, not a direct personal identifier.

PT_LAST.label: PT_LAST
PT_LAST.description: Composite patient/subject identifier or label, commonly combining site code and patient number, such as SITE-PT. Used as the row-level patient key in reporting.

PT_STATUS.label: PT_STATUS
PT_STATUS.description: Patient-level disposition/status flag summarizing subject state in the study. Observed values: ALL; D; D ALL; F; F D; W; W ALL; W D; W D ALL.

PHYSICIAN.label: PHYSICIAN
PHYSICIAN.description: Investigator or treating/enrolling physician associated with the patient record, when available.

GENDER.label: GENDER
GENDER.description: Patient sex/gender value as captured by the source study system. Observed values: F; FEMALE; Female; M; MALE; Male.

PT_AGE.label: PT_AGE
PT_AGE.description: Patient age at the relevant study baseline, screening, consent, or enrollment time point. Observed non-blank range: -1 to 100.

NYHA_CLASS_ENR.label: NYHA_CLASS_ENR
NYHA_CLASS_ENR.description: NYHA functional class or heart-failure status at enrollment/baseline. Observed values: CLASS II; CLASS IIIA; CLASS IIIB; CLASS IV; I; II; III; IV; IV (AMBULATORY); IV (NON-AMBULATORY); NO HEART FAILURE; NO HF; NOT ASSESSED; NOT DETERMINED; NOT DONE; UNK.

TO_CHAR(P.CONSENT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.CONSENT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.CONSENT_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Date the patient signed informed consent or consent was recorded, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

CONSENT_REV.label: CONSENT_REV
CONSENT_REV.description: Informed consent form revision/version used for the patient consent, often including revision letter, version number, date, and/or country/language suffix.

PROT_REV.label: PROT_REV
PROT_REV.description: Protocol revision/version applicable to the patient record at consent, notification, enrollment, or procedure. Observed values: 1; A; B; C; D; E; F; G; H; K; VERSION B; VERSION C; VERSION E; and others.

TO_CHAR(P.NOTIF_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.NOTIF_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.NOTIF_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Patient notification date from the source system, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Date the patient was enrolled or formally entered into the study, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

TO_CHAR(P.IMP_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.IMP_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.IMP_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Date of device implant, index procedure, ablation, or relevant study procedure, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

SYST_REV_FG.label: SYST_REV_FG
SYST_REV_FG.description: System revision flag indicating whether a system revision occurred or was applicable for the patient. Observed values: Y.

RAND_CONFIG.label: RAND_CONFIG
RAND_CONFIG.description: Randomization configuration or study-specific randomized configuration value. Observed values: APPROVED, PENDING RANDOMIZATION; CONTROL; EXISTING; INTERMEDIATE; LOW; MEDICAL THERAPY (CONTROL) GROUP; N; NEW; RANDOMIZED; ROLL-IN; SCREEN FAILURE; TREATMENT; Y; and others.

RAND_ARM.label: RAND_ARM
RAND_ARM.description: Randomization arm or assigned treatment/control group. Observed values: AMULET; CAV; CONTROL; DEVICE; MEDICAL THERAPY (CONTROL) GROUP; MITRACLIP DEVICE (DEVICE) GROUP; NAVITOR; NOAC; PORTICO; SINGLE ARM; TREATMENT; TRICLIP DEVICE (DEVICE) GROUP; VIRTUAL; and others.

DEVICE_TYPE.label: DEVICE_TYPE
DEVICE_TYPE.description: Device type, therapy type, or implant category. Observed values: ASSERT-IQ TM INSERTABLE CARDIAC MONITOR; CLIP; ETERNA SCS; IPG; LEAD; LVAD; N; PROCLAIM DRG; PROCLAIM ELITE 5; PROCLAIM ELITE 7; PROCLAIM IPG 5; PROCLAIM XR; PRODIGY; PRODIGY MRI; VALVE; Y.

PG_MANUF.label: PG_MANUF
PG_MANUF.description: Pulse generator manufacturer for cardiac rhythm/device studies. Observed values: ABBOTT; ABBOTT/SJM; BIOTRONIK; BOSTON SCIENTIFIC; LIVANOVA; MEDTRONIC; OTHER; SJM/ABBOTT; UNKNOWN.

PG_MODEL.label: PG_MODEL
PG_MODEL.description: Pulse generator model recorded for cardiac rhythm/device studies, when applicable.

PG_SERIAL.label: PG_SERIAL
PG_SERIAL.description: Pulse generator serial number recorded for cardiac rhythm/device studies, when applicable.

DEVICE_MODEL.label: DEVICE_MODEL
DEVICE_MODEL.description: Model or size identifier for the study device, implant, or comparator device used for the patient, when applicable.

DEVICE_SERIAL.label: DEVICE_SERIAL
DEVICE_SERIAL.description: Serial number or unique device identifier for the implanted or study device, when captured by the source system.

TO_CHAR(P.WD_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.WD_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.WD_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Withdrawal, discontinuation, screen-failure, or study-exit date for the patient, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

WD_REASON.label: WD_REASON
WD_REASON.description: Reason the patient withdrew, discontinued, screen-failed, was lost to follow-up, died, or otherwise exited study participation.

DEATH_FG.label: DEATH_FG
DEATH_FG.description: Flag indicating whether the patient death indicator is recorded. Observed values: Y.

IMPLANT_TYPE.label: IMPLANT_TYPE
IMPLANT_TYPE.description: Study-specific implant or procedure type. Observed values: DE NOVO IMPLANT; IDE; IMPLANT; INDEX ABLATION PROCEDURE; INITIAL; INITIAL PROCEDURE; INSERTION; NEW IMPLANT; REPLACEMENT; SYSTEM UPGRADE; and others.

TO_CHAR(P.DEATH_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.DEATH_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.DEATH_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Patient death date, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated and applicable.

SOURCE.label: SOURCE
SOURCE.description: Source-system or procedure-source text for the patient record, sometimes containing source category, region, visit/procedure timing, or procedure-event strings.

OLD_SITE.label: OLD_SITE
OLD_SITE.description: Prior site code or migrated legacy site value, when a patient/site was transferred or converted from an earlier source-system site identifier.

FCE.label: FCE
FCE.description: Field clinical engineer or field clinical contact associated with the patient/site record, when available.

CRA_NAME.label: CRA_NAME
CRA_NAME.description: Clinical research associate assigned to the patient/site/study record, when available.

PT_TRANS_FG.label: PT_TRANS_FG
PT_TRANS_FG.description: Patient transfer flag indicating whether the patient was transferred between sites or source-system contexts, when populated.

PT_GROUP_VALUE.label: PT_GROUP_VALUE
PT_GROUP_VALUE.description: Patient group, cohort, analysis population, or study-specific classification. Observed values include 12_MONTH; 30_DAY; ALIVE; ENROLLMENT; EXTENSION COHORT; GROUP 1 through GROUP 5; MAIN STUDY; ROLL-IN; and others.

WEIGHT.label: WEIGHT
WEIGHT.description: Patient weight value at the relevant baseline, enrollment, or procedure time point. Observed non-blank range: 1 to 960.

WEIGHT_UNIT.label: WEIGHT_UNIT
WEIGHT_UNIT.description: Unit of measure for WEIGHT. Observed values: G; KG; Kg; kg; LB; LBS; lbs.

TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_RECV_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_RECV_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.ENROLL_RECV_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Date enrollment documentation or data was received/recorded by the source workflow, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

TO_CHAR(P.MON_TRIGGER_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').label: TO_CHAR(P.MON_TRIGGER_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD')
TO_CHAR(P.MON_TRIGGER_DT,'YYYY-MM-DD').description: Monitoring trigger date used to initiate monitoring/workflow activities for the patient record, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD when populated.

RETROSPECTIVE_FG.label: RETROSPECTIVE_FG
RETROSPECTIVE_FG.description: Flag indicating whether the patient record is retrospective or prospectively captured. Observed values: N; Y.

description: Abbott personnel assignments to clinical studies and study sites (Study Organizer / SO Personnel), including role definitions, assignment history, assignment status, and organizational responsibility. Contains both study-level roles (when Site is blank) and site-level roles, enabling teams to identify who is responsible for a study or site, track role coverage, monitor resource allocation, and analyze staffing changes over time.

STUDY_TITLE.description: Study title or name of the study.

ASSIGNED = currently assigned to this role in the study or study site; COMPLETE = the study completed so the assignment ended; TERM = the person is no longer with Abbott; UNASSIGNED = the person is no longer assigned to this role. ASSIGN_CURR_FG.label: ASSIGN_CURR_FG

name: Clinical Site - Site Nomination Header
description: Site nomination and site qualification form header dataset for clinical studies. Contains ONE row per nomination/qualification form (identified by NOM_ID), capturing form type (Nomination vs Qualification), study details, site identity and address, principal investigator, submission and approval workflow (submitted/approved timestamps and persons, approval status, disapproval reason, form status), and participation outcome (whether the site declined and why). IMPORTANT: This is one of TWO tightly related knowledge bases that must be used together. This HEADER KB holds the form-level facts (one row per form); the companion 'Clinical Site - Site Nomination Details' KB holds the individual form questions and responses (many rows per form). They are joined on NOM_ID. To answer questions that involve both form-level attributes (approval status, dates, site, study, decline reason) and specific question responses, combine both KBs on NOM_ID.

FORM_TYPE.label: FORM_TYPE
FORM_TYPE.description: Type of form. Observed values: Nomination, Qualification.

NOM_ID.label: NOM_ID
NOM_ID.description: Unique identifier representing a site nomination or site qualification form. JOIN KEY: use this to join to the 'Clinical Site - Site Nomination Details' KB, which holds one row per form question for the same NOM_ID.

STUDY_TITLE.label: STUDY_TITLE
STUDY_TITLE.description: Study title or name of the study.

SITE.label: SITE
SITE.description: Site code; the global unique identifier for the clinical site.

SITE_NAME.label: SITE_NAME
SITE_NAME.description: Site name; the clinical study site.

CITY.label: CITY
CITY.description: City in which the site is located.

STATE.label: STATE
STATE.description: State in which the site is located.

COUNTRY.label: COUNTRY
COUNTRY.description: Country in which the site is located.

ZIP.label: ZIP
ZIP.description: Zip/postal code in which the site is located.

PI_FIRST.label: PI_FIRST
PI_FIRST.description: First name of the Principal Investigator at the time of submission of the nomination/qualification form.

PI_LAST.label: PI_LAST
PI_LAST.description: Last name of the Principal Investigator at the time of submission of the nomination/qualification form.

APPROVAL_STATUS.label: APPROVAL_STATUS
APPROVAL_STATUS.description: Approval status of the site qualification (not applicable for site nomination).

APPROVED_TS.label: APPROVED_TS
APPROVED_TS.description: Date the site qualification was approved.

APPROVED_BY.label: APPROVED_BY
APPROVED_BY.description: Person who approved the site qualification.

DISAPPROVAL_REASON.label: DISAPPROVAL_REASON
DISAPPROVAL_REASON.description: If the site qualification was disapproved, the reason for disapproval.

COMMENTS.label: COMMENTS
COMMENTS.description: Free-text reviewer/evaluator comments captured on the nomination or qualification form. This is the primary source of QUALITATIVE, narrative assessment about the site and its team. Use this column to answer subjective or descriptive questions such as how involved, engaged, dedicated, responsive, experienced, motivated, or committed the Principal Investigator (PI) and Research Coordinator (RC) or site staff are, site strengths and concerns, feasibility notes, enrollment expectations, and any other narrative observations that are not captured in the structured columns. When a question asks about attitudes, commitment, involvement, dedication, quality, or overall impressions of a site/PI/RC, search this COMMENTS text.

SITE_DECLINED.label: SITE_DECLINED
SITE_DECLINED.description: Whether the site declined to participate. Y = Yes. Observed values: Y, N.

name: Clinical Site - Site Nomination Details
description: Site nomination and site qualification form question/response detail dataset for clinical studies. Contains MANY rows per form (one row per question) identified by NOM_ID, capturing each question asked on the nomination/qualification form, its response, its display order, and whether it was mandatory. IMPORTANT: This is one of TWO tightly related knowledge bases that must be used together. This DETAILS KB holds the individual questions and answers; the companion 'Clinical Site - Site Nomination Header' KB holds the form-level facts (study, site, PI, submission/approval workflow, decline outcome) with one row per form. They are joined on NOM_ID. To answer questions about specific form responses in the context of a site, study, or approval outcome, combine both KBs on NOM_ID.

NOM_ID.label: NOM_ID
NOM_ID.description: Unique identifier representing a site nomination or site qualification form. JOIN KEY: use this to join to the 'Clinical Site - Site Nomination Header' KB, which holds one row of form-level facts for the same NOM_ID. Multiple detail rows share the same NOM_ID (one per question).

QUESTION_ID.label: QUESTION_ID
QUESTION_ID.description: Identifier of the question on the form. May be null in some cases.

QUESTION_LABEL.label: QUESTION_LABEL
QUESTION_LABEL.description: The question asked on the nomination/qualification form.

QUESTION_RESPONSE.label: QUESTION_RESPONSE
QUESTION_RESPONSE.description: Response/answer to the question on the form.

DISP_SEQ.label: DISP_SEQ
DISP_SEQ.description: Display order of the question on the form.

MANDATORY_FG.label: MANDATORY_FG
MANDATORY_FG.description: Whether or not the question was mandatory. Observed values: Y, N.
